PreToolUse.command: node -e "const input=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]||'{}'); const cmd=input.command||''; if(/atlassian-cli\s+(confluence|conf)\s+/.test(cmd)){const writes=['page\\s+(create|update|upsert|append|delete|move)','page\\s+label-(add|remove)','page\\s+property-(set|delete)','attachment\\s+(upload|delete)','template\\s+(create|delete)']; const isWrite=writes.some(w=>new RegExp(w).test(cmd)); if(isWrite){const action=cmd.match(/(?:page|attachment|template)\\s+(\\S+)/)?.[1]||'unknown'; const risk=/(delete|remove)/.test(action)?'HIGH':/(create|upload)/.test(action)?'LOW':'MEDIUM'; console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'⚠️ Confluence WRITE operation detected: '+action+' (Risk: '+risk+')\\nCommand: '+cmd+'\\nPlease confirm with the user before proceeding.'}));process.exit(0)}} console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'}))" -- "$TOOL_INPUT"
PreToolUse.comment: Detects Confluence write operations: page create/update/upsert/append/delete/move, label/property changes, attachment upload/delete, template create/delete

PreToolUse.command: node -e "const input=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]||'{}'); const cmd=input.command||''; if(/atlassian-cli\s+jira\s+/.test(cmd)){const writes=['issue\\s+(create|bulk-create|update|bulk-update|delete|transition|assign|archive)','issue\\s+label-(add|remove)','issue\\s+link','sprint\\s+(create|add-issues|rename)','comment\\s+(add|edit)','attachment\\s+(upload|delete)','worklog\\s+add','filter\\s+(create|update|delete)','component\\s+create','version\\s+create','backlog\\s+add']; const isWrite=writes.some(w=>new RegExp(w).test(cmd)); if(isWrite){const action=cmd.match(/(?:issue|sprint|comment|attachment|worklog|filter|component|version|backlog)\\s+(\\S+)/)?.[1]||'unknown'; const risk=/(delete|bulk-delete|archive)/.test(action)?'HIGH':/(bulk-create|bulk-update)/.test(action)?'CRITICAL':/(create|add|upload)/.test(action)?'LOW':'MEDIUM'; console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'⚠️ Jira WRITE operation detected: '+action+' (Risk: '+risk+')\\nCommand: '+cmd+'\\nPlease confirm with the user before proceeding.'}));process.exit(0)}} console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'}))" -- "$TOOL_INPUT"
PreToolUse.comment: Detects Jira write operations: issue CRUD, transitions, assignments, sprint management, comments, attachments, worklogs, filters, components, versions
